changelog: complete mobile Investigate and cleaner viewer sessions
Investigate now stacks captured sessions and call analysis on phones, keeping the full workflow within the viewport.
The closed SIP drawer, header telemetry and navigation no longer widen the mobile page.
changelog_es: complete mobile Investigate and quieter role-aware polling
Investigate now stacks the session list and selected-call analysis on narrow screens instead of pushing the detail hundreds of pixels off-screen.
The closed SIP message drawer no longer widens the mobile document; navigation and header telemetry scroll inside their own bounded regions.
